title: Recipe Multi-Servings Scaling, Meal Type Dispatch & 1-Click Shortfall Purchase
acceptance_criteria: Add an interactive Servings Stepper (1 to 8 portions) in RecipeCard.tsx that dynamically recalculates required ingredient quantities and total recipe macros in real-time.
Add Meal Type selector (Сніданок / Обід / Вечеря / Перекус) in RecipeCard.tsx and pass selected type and servings to POST /api/v1/recipes/{id}/cook.

When recipe ingredients are missing, display an immediate 'Купити бракуючі (N)' button directly on the card to add exact shortfall to the shopping list with 1 click without requiring a 422 error cycle.
Replace developer jargon like 'Приготувати (422 Тест)' with clean user-facing state ('Не вистачає інгредієнтів').
After successful 1-Click Cook, show toast with actual cooked servings and meal type, and refresh inventory stock and macro progress.
